name: AquaPure UAE
shortDescription: Water filtration and purification company serving all seven Emirates of the UAE.
description: AquaPure UAE installs, services and repairs domestic and commercial water filtration systems across all seven Emirates — reverse osmosis drinking-water purifiers, whole-house and whole-villa filtration, water softeners, UV disinfection, filter and membrane replacement, and annual maintenance contracts. Every job starts with a free on-site water test and a fixed written quotation in AED.

_social_note: Deliberately empty. These URLs become `sameAs` in Organization/LocalBusiness JSON-LD, which is how a search or AI system decides two mentions of 'AquaPure' are the same entity. A bare domain (https://facebook.com/) tells it nothing and is rejected at the content boundary. Add real profile URLs only — e.g. { "platform": "facebook", "url": "https://www.facebook.com/<page>" }. Google Business Profile is the highest-value entry here.
_stats_note: Statistics deliberately do not live here. Every figure about the business (customers served, rating, review count, years trading) is a claim in content/claims.json and is published only when that claim is verified. This is what stopped the site rendering '0+ Happy customers' to crawlers while the JSON said 12,000+.
